SECTION 1. THE GIFT

1.1 The Rothbury Family Charitable Fund (the "Donor") hereby makes an unrestricted gift of One Hundred Fifty Thousand Dollars ($150,000.00) to Southshore Food Alliance, Inc. (the "Donee").

1.2 The gift is unrestricted. The Donee may apply the funds to any purpose consistent with its charitable mission and its governing documents, as determined in the sole discretion of the Donee's board of directors. The Donor imposes no programmatic, geographic, or budgetary restriction on the use of the funds.

1.3 The Donor imposes no restriction on the timing of expenditure. The Donee may expend the gift in a single fiscal year, may spend it over multiple years, or may add all or part of the gift to its operating reserve. There is no period of performance associated with this gift and no unexpended balance is required to be returned to the Donor at any time.

1.4 The gift is not conditioned on the receipt of any matching contribution, the achievement of any performance target, or the completion of any deliverable.

SECTION 2. NO REPORTING REQUIREMENTS

2.1 The Donee is not required to submit any narrative report, financial report, interim report, or final report to the Donor with respect to this gift.

2.2 The Donor does not require an accounting of expenditures, a budget, a budget revision request, or any certification regarding the use of the funds.

2.3 The Donee is not required to segregate the gift in a separate fund or cost center, and the Donor will not audit or review the Donee's records with respect to this gift.

2.4 The Donee's ordinary practice of publishing an annual report is welcomed but is not a condition of this gift.

The Rothbury Family Charitable Fund — Gift Agreement RFCF-2026-GIFT-0034 — Page 2 of 4
[[PAGE]]
The Rothbury Family Charitable Fund — Gift Agreement RFCF-2026-GIFT-0034 — Page 3 of 4

SECTION 3. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

3.1 Within thirty (30) days after receipt of the funds, the Donee shall send a written acknowledgement letter to the Donor at the address on page 1. The acknowledgement letter shall state the amount received, the date of receipt, and confirm that no goods or services were provided to the Donor in exchange for the gift, in the form required by Section 170(f)(8) of the Internal Revenue Code.

3.2 The acknowledgement letter is the only document the Donee is required to provide to the Donor in connection with this gift.

3.3 The acknowledgement letter shall be addressed to the Rothbury Family Charitable Fund, c/o Ainsworth Trust Company, and shall not be addressed to any individual member of the Rothbury family.

SECTION 4. RECOGNITION AND USE OF NAME

4.1 The Donor requests that this gift be recorded without public recognition. The Donee shall not use the Donor's name, the Rothbury family name, or any variant thereof in any press release, social media post, donor listing, newsletter, event program, signage, or other public communication without the prior written consent of Ainsworth Trust Company.

4.2 The Donee may report the gift in aggregate giving categories in its annual report provided the Donor is not individually identified.

4.3 Nothing in this Section restricts the Donee from making any disclosure required by law or by generally accepted accounting principles, including disclosure on IRS Form 990 and in the Donee's audited financial statements.

SECTION 5. REPRESENTATIONS OF THE DONEE

5.1 The Donee represents that it is an organization described in Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code and classified as a public charity under Section 509(a)(1), that it is in good standing in the State of North Carolina, and that it is not a disqualified person with respect to the Donor.

5.2 The Donee shall notify Ainsworth Trust Company promptly, and in no event later than thirty (30) days, if the Donee's tax-exempt status changes, is revoked, or comes under examination by the Internal Revenue Service.

5.3 The Donee represents that no goods, services, or other benefits have been or will be provided to the Donor, to any donor advisor to the Fund, or to any member of the Rothbury family in consideration of this gift.

SECTION 6. GENERAL

6.1 This gift is complete upon transfer of the funds and is irrevocable. The Donor retains no interest in the funds and no right of recall.

6.2 This Agreement contains no condition subsequent. Failure to comply with Section 3 or Section 4 does not create a right of repayment, and the Donor's sole recourse is to decline to make future gifts.

6.3 This Agreement may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties and is governed by the laws of the State of North Carolina.

6.4 Questions regarding this gift may be directed to Vivienne Hardcastle, Senior Philanthropic Advisor, Ainsworth Trust Company, (704) 555-0173.
